title: The Lobster Trap Tally
story: Ask Nico about Tuesday's haul off Seal Ledge and the numbers grow with every telling, along with the lobster, which is now the size of a wheelbarrow. Four skippers went out that morning, each with a different bait and buoys of a different color. The lobster co-op's tally sheet wants facts, not fish stories. Who used which bait and which buoys, and how many traps did each skipper haul?

theme.title: The Lobster Trap Tally

Four skippers went out that morning, each with a different bait and buoys of a different color. The lobster co-op's tally sheet wants facts, not fish stories. Who used which bait and which buoys, and how many traps did each skipper haul?

texts: Nico did not bait with herring.
Nico hauled fewer traps than Yusuf.
The skipper with orange buoys hauled neither 20 nor 50 traps.
The skipper who baited with herring had lime buoys.
Arlo hauled more traps than the skipper who baited with squid.
Of the skipper who baited with pogies and the skipper who hauled 30 traps, one is Arlo and the other is Yusuf.
Of the skipper who baited with pogies and the skipper who baited with squid, one hauled 40 traps and the other hauled 50 traps.
The skipper who baited with pogies did not have white buoys.
